vehicles.mispar_rechev: skip: licence plate — a per-vehicle lookup identifier, never shown
vehicles.misgeret: skip: chassis (VIN) number — a per-vehicle identifier, never shown
vehicles.tozeret_cd: skip: numeric maker code, one-to-one with tozeret_nm which is shown
vehicles.tozeret_nm: chart-brands, chart-box, chart-models, chart-ev, insight:brand, insight:model — the brand is the name without the (truncated) plant country, so one brand's plants are merged
vehicles.sug_degem: chart-vintage, chart-owner — P = private, M = commercial
vehicles.degem_cd: skip: numeric model code, meaningless without the maker's code table
vehicles.degem_nm: skip: 7,209 factory model codes (e.g. BK12Z) — kinuy_mishari carries the readable name
vehicles.ramat_gimur: skip: 2,242 free-text trim levels (GLX, LX…) — no meaning across makers
vehicles.ramat_eivzur_betihuty: skip: safety-equipment level is empty for 97% of rows
vehicles.kvutzat_zihum: chart-pollution, insight:pollution — recorded only for 2007+ vehicles (~36% of rows), disclosed
vehicles.shnat_yitzur: chart-vintage, chart-age, chart-box, chart-ev, kpi:med_age, insight:age, insight:peak
vehicles.degem_manoa: skip: 5,670 engine-model codes — not meaningful without a lookup
vehicles.mivchan_acharon_dt: insight:test_after — last inspection compared with licence expiry
vehicles.tokef_dt: chart-lapse, chart-age, chart-box, kpi:last12, kpi:trend, kpi:med_age, insight:trend, insight:ev, insight:test_after — licence expiry = when the vehicle went inactive
vehicles.tzeva_cd: skip: numeric colour code, one-to-one with tzeva_rechev which is shown
vehicles.zmig_kidmi: skip: free-format tyre spec (4,167 spellings) — technical, no story for readers
vehicles.zmig_ahori: skip: free-format tyre spec, 12% empty — technical, no story for readers
vehicles.moed_aliya_lakvish: skip: first road month is empty for 68% of rows (only post-1999 entries); shnat_yitzur covers vehicle age
vehicles.kinuy_mishari: chart-models, chart-ev, insight:model — trade name normalised across spellings (MAZDA 3 = MAZDA3)
